messages:
Maya: Weekend dilemma 1 — donut run at 10am (Blue Bottle downtown has limited-edition maple-bacon) or dawn kayak at the estuary 6:30am? who's doing what? :doughnut::kayak_person:
Ethan: Donuts all the way. maple-bacon sounds illegal in the best way. 
Ravi: Kayak for me. low tide and glassy water at 6:30, perfect photos. can bring a waterproof case for phones.
Jules: i'm torn. i like early stuff but 6:30 is brutal. if i skip kayak i'll take a donut and coffee.
Maya: quick logistics: donut run is about 30min from office, could swing by after morning standup. kayak needs a short drive to the estuary and life jackets.
Ethan: i can swing by after standup. will grab a dozen if people want. vote with "donut" or "kayak"
Ravi: kayak
Jules: donut
Maya: donut
Ethan: tally 3 donut, 1 kayak. kayakers still welcome ofc.
sync-bot: FYI: City park lot at the estuary opens at 6:00am Sat. Limited spots; overflow parking on Harbor Road.
Ravi: good note @sync-bot. i can carpool 2 people if needed, leaves at 5:30.
Jules: @Ravi appreciate it but i'll takethe donuts route this time. my call: donut + porch reading.
Maya: who wants vegan/gluten-free options? i'll ask Blue Bottle to toss extras in a separate box.
Ethan: one vegan please (that's me). also can we save 2 plain glazed for @Sam? he's out today but mentioned craving donuts earlier.
Maya: noted. will add "save for Sam" to the order. ETA to office ~10:15 if we go after standup.
Ravi: kayakers: meet at Estuary Boat Ramp 6:20, bring layers and sun hat. there's sometimes a seal pod near marker 3.
Jules: tiny PSA: my bike lock is broken so i might be late if i have to find a new lock. someone remind me to bring cash?
Ethan: i'll Venmo the donut share. @Jules i'll bring an extra cable tie as a temporary lock if it helps.
Maya: final: donut run wins by majority. kayakers still good to go. i'll post order specifics in the morning and DM @Sam about his saved donuts. enjoy the weekend whichever you pick! :sunny:
Ravi: have fun y'all. send pics from the seal pod if you see them.
Jules: enjoy donuts. i'll be the one with crumbs on my keyboard Monday :coffee:
Ethan: see you Saturday! :doughnut:
